selection: These are the three already selected positive-RPE seed-2002 checkpoints with measured first motor-crossing advances. Selection predates this first-action replay.

first_action_utility_rule.first_DOWN_is_valid_hit: same centered game utility as its resolved judgement

diagnostic_rpe: first_action_utility minus the unchanged saved expected_utility_before for that outcome; do not update the predictor with this diagnostic value
source_replay: Reconstruct the exact saved 384-note seed-2002 on configuration; replay only through outcome 377; require every observed training event to match the existing long-continuation ledger exactly.
action_association: Use the existing action_record note-window mapping: a DOWN belongs to the one note whose time is between 500 ms after the action and the game expiry offset before/at the action. Report all actions, including those outside any note window.
primary_endpoint: actual scored-judgement RPE sign versus diagnostic first-action RPE sign at outcomes 372, 373 and 377, with every DOWN for those notes

interpretation.support_attribution_gap: At a selected harmful update, first DOWN is null and first-action RPE has the opposite sign to the actual positive scored-judgement RPE.
interpretation.weaken_attribution_gap: First DOWN is the scored hit or both RPE signs agree at that checkpoint.
interpretation.inconclusive: Action association or deterministic replay cannot be verified.

prohibitions: no checkpoint or seed selection after viewing first-action results
stop: Save raw replay, independent audit and one report; do not launch a corrected training run.
